label: H.R. 4593
title: SHOWER Act

items.snippet: Specifically, the bill adopts the definition of showerhead established by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME).
The bill also requires the Department of Energy (DOE) to revise existing regulations to reflect the new definition.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
